description:
## Decision

Do not merge or replay commit `e1a5ce75`. The original goal—replace nested Enum decisions with clause helpers—was evaluated against the epic northstar and rejected.

## Evidence

The implementation adds 24 helper identities and 62 clauses, raises source work from 4081 to 5456, executable-fact work from 401 to 1585, changed-revision wakes from 1430 to 2644, and aggregate RuntimeDemand walks from 1928 to 2003. It deletes an existing less-work ceiling while work rises. It also adds list-specific split algorithms beside generic ones, unreachable empty-list repair arms after nonempty callers, and a formatting-sensitive raw-source scan as a structural test.

Those are duplicate authorities and extra reactive work, not simplification. The old PR #138 must be closed and its branch deleted after descendants are reparented.

## Retained learning

Two measurements are hypotheses only: a merge-sort dispatch shape reduced selected retention/capture counts, and list-specific split paths reduced some callable-owner positions. Existing fz-5xp.85 owns any future narrow, current-main experiment. It must prove net causal work does not increase, preserve one algorithm authority, and use semantic/telemetry evidence rather than text scanning.

No replacement implementation is authorized by this ticket.

comments.text: Implemented clause-driven decision helpers across the specified Enum functions. The structural test was proven red before the rewrite and now pins that every remaining code-level if is a single one-line value choice. Elixir oracle and all 715 fixture-matrix legs pass; allocation goldens are unchanged (including enum_sort at 22 cells / 352 bytes native), and the sort recursion stays beside cons construction to preserve reuse. Compiler census changes account for the concrete helper specializations without blind escapes or unexplained work; the existing fz-f98.14.3 audit establishes this breadth is linear and dispatch-relevant. Full gates: compiler 2020 passed / 6 ignored, runtime 260 passed, CLI 30 passed, doctests, AOT, clippy -D warnings, fmt, and diff checks all green. Commit: 178805b59.

Current-main integration is final at e1a5ce75c. Clause helpers own their recursive continuations, and list-specific split paths preserve callable transport and allocation behavior. The surface-membership ratchet remains non-vacuous at 316 observations per affected arrival with zero escapes after generic reducer wrappers leave the list path. Final stack gates: fixture matrix 754/754, compiler library 2060 passed/5 ignored, runtime 269/269, CLI 30/30, doctests, AOT variadic integration, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene. PR #138 remains stacked on the now-green #137.
